builds.name: King Siegbert
builds.desc: Who needs Sigurd when you have Siegbert. With a respectable 52 Atk and 43 Spd, combined with his Swift Sparrow weapon ability, his jumps up to 56 attack and 47 speed! When paired with Brazen Atk, and at >80% Hp, his attack rockets to a devastating 63, with 54 speed, meaning he can double anything he desires. His 33 defense allows him to take a beating and drop him into Brazen Atk/Spd and Desperation range. If combined with Hone Calvary and 2 Goad Cav buffs, he has 77 Atk and 68 Spd. No Red, Green, will survive that onslaught, nor most blue units. With the exception of Blue Armor Units like Effie and Winter's Envoy Robin and/or Nowi with Triangle Adept will survive. However, if you let him get attacked his Draconic Aura will activate for a massive 100 damage + his second attack of 77 for a total of 177 damage! Ardent Sacrifice can also be used to lower his Hp into both desperation and brazen range after just 1 use.

builds.name: Death by Moonbow
builds.desc: Thanks to the new Heavy Blade 3 seal, Siegbert can essentially become a better Brave Roy. His base Dark Greatsword gives a +4 Atk/Spd boost, and when combined with Swift Sparrow 2, he reaches 58/46 on Player Phase without any buffs. Reposition is an excellent assist, especially when combined with Siegbert's 3 movement. If you have a -HP Siegbert, you can go for Ardent Sacrifice to immediately reach Desperation 3. Moonbow is a standard, and if you reach Desperation and have Heavy Blade active, you can proc it with the second hit. Dragon Fang is another good option, as Siegbert naturally comes with it and it will have the same cooldown as Moonbow if Heavy Blade is active. If you want a more reliable way to reach Desperation without having him take a hit or use Ardent Sacrifice, you can use Fury 3 as his A slot. Siegbert's natural Death Blow 3 is also usable. Desperation is excellent combined with the rest of the build, since Siegbert can nearly double every unit in the game. Swordbreaker 3 can be used if you want him to bait other swords. For his C skill, Hone Cavalry or Fortify Cavalry will help him support the rest of the team, although the player can use any C skill they choose. The Heavy Blade 3 seal is a necessity for this build, as it lets him proc his specials quicker and brings him to Brave Roy's level.
